title: Finn Wolfhard directs new video for George Harrison’s Give Me Love (Give Me Peace On Earth) | 2025
content:
Stranger Things star Finn Wolfhard has directed a new music video for George Harrison’s 1973 song ‘Give Me Love (Give Me Peace On Earth)’.

Finn is one of the sweetest and most talented people I know of his generation, and he is the perfect person to direct a video for my dad. My dad would have loved this, and I hope his wonderful, creative, heartfelt ideas help this song reach another generation. Great job, Finn – we love you.
Dhani Harrison

Wolfhard met Harrison’s son Dhani while working on Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire in London, and later visited Dhani and Olivia Harrison at Friar Park. More than a year later he was contacted by comedian Fred Armisen, who put his name forward as a potential director for the video.

I got a random text from Fred after a few days and he was like, ‘Hey, the George Harrison estate is trying to figure out a director for ‘Give Me Love’, but they haven’t found anyone yet. I threw your name in the hat.’ I was shocked. It was flattering enough that he even mentioned me. Then it was a coincidence that I already knew Dhani.
Finn Wolfhard
Vulture

The project was managed remotely, with Wolfhard sending photographs of his Friar Park visit, and even acting elements to send to the animators. The animation director was Akash Jones, and the additional animators were Nikolas Radulovich, Edwin Alvarenga, Colin Lepper, and Abbey Collings. The puppet sculptor was Karen Valleau.

Sometimes I would send a video of myself doing the movement of George so that they could take it. From them, it was a lot of giving notes over the phone and texts, and having my friends round out and take liberties where I wasn’t able to. They did an unbelievable amount of work every day.
Finn Wolfhard
Vulture
